item.text: {"claim_count":14,"content_failure_reasons":["The normalized map omits the communiqué’s substantive economic-performance and labor-market evidence in blocks 2–3, including reported growth, unemployment, employment creation, consumption, investment, wages, trade, and foreign-investment results.
